name: Seeed reTerminal E1004
description: 13.3 inch 6-colour Spectra 6 ePaper terminal, ESP32-S3, 1200x1600 portrait-native panel. Uses a Tesserae ESP32 bin client firmware adapted for the Seeed E1004 hardware.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. Pair with an E1004-adapted Tesserae ESP32 bin firmware; the server renders 1200x1600 4-bpp Spectra 6 frames, while the client firmware must provide the Seeed pinout, T133A01 dual-controller refresh, power control, and battery telemetry.
